title: Chapter 826
paragraphs: Chapter 826
Episode 208. The Barmel Alliance doing its job (3)
The knights were taken aback, but they kept their salutes without showing it. After a bout of vomiting, Murakan put on a solemn face as if nothing happened.
[...Please come in.]

The housekeepers, Luret, and the former family masters stepped forward and bowed their heads. Jin was still not used to being greeted like this in public. While bowing, Luret discreetly used earth magic to clean up Murakan's vomit.
"Butler Luret, my visit today with the little master is simply to encourage the knights, so there's no need to be so nervous."
[I am simply grateful that the great black dragon has taken his golden time to oversee our family.]
"Haha, it's also to see the things that I previously asked you to prepare. Is everything ready?"
[Regrettably, we have not been able to obtain them. And it is very likely that we will not be able to procure those items in the future either, so I sincerely hope for your understanding.]
Murakan pulled Luret close, his veins bulging in his neck.
'Hey, Luret! It wasn't a big ask, was it?'

'Should we divert the manpower of our family, the Alliance, to collect limited edition spring picture books in this situation? Pull yourself together. Besides, you came here and started vomiting right away. It's so embarrassing for me.'
'Hmph! Whether it was a thousand years ago or now, you're unbearably picky.'
'Say one more thing. I'll throw you in the underground dungeon with my authority as the butler.'
'Oh my, that's terrifying.'

The knights who opened the way couldn't hear their whispers, but the elders did. Ballas and Tasha's faces were swollen trying to hold back their laughter, while Alpen closed his eyes with a bitter feeling.
However, the relationship between Murakan and Luret was not actually bad. Rather, they were very close, and Luret often joked first.
For a while, Jin and Murakan looked around at the knights and encouraged them. Most of the knights in line were wearing dirty armor. They had just finished their duties and gathered here.

"I am always proud that you are my knights. Now, disband and return to your positions. And the teams that have remaining break time, come to the central training ground later. Murakan will personally act as a sparring partner and evaluate your achievements."
"Sir!"
"Those who have to go back to their missions right away, don't be too disappointed. There will be many opportunities like this in the future."
A spar with Murakan.
Of course, the knights had never dreamed of such a thing. There was no reason for such a noble and powerful being to bother sparring.
"We understand!"
When the knights dispersed full of anticipation, Murakan glanced at Jin.
"Kid, a spar? You never mentioned that before."
"It's part of the encouragement. Why, you don't want to?"
"It's not like me."
"I think a guardian dragon helping knights train without any distinction looks cooler."
"Up to about seven stars, if I breathe wrong, they die."
"Then you should be very careful with your opponent. Are you saying it's difficult?"
"There is nothing difficult for this Murakan."

"Good. As I just told the knights, this will be a regular event from now on. Of course, I won't let them fight one-on-one. At least they'll fight in teams, and the knights will fight with all their might. As you know, one of the factors that grows the warrior the fastest is such an experience. Full-powered battle experience."
"Well, that's true."
[The little master has given a good suggestion. I was also frustrated with Murakan's idle talk.]
"Huh, Luret's words are becoming more refined. I remember you cried a little when I came back for the first time."
[In return, if you conduct a great spar with the knights today, I'll give you the best spring picture book that I personally acquired.]
"Hahaha, as expected, Luret, there's no one like you! Fine, call all those who have spare time, I'll help them all improve by one step! So, we start right now?"
Murakan set off for the central training ground with enthusiasm. Luret chuckled at his retreating figure.
[I sometimes feel relieved that this fool is still a fool.]
"I feel the same way, butler."
[Let's go in. I've sorted as much as I could, but there are quite a few reports that you should check personally.]
A stack of reports was laid on the desk in the office. Jin carefully reviewed the reports for a while.

"As expected, there's no problem with the internal affairs. The financial situation has improved a lot as a result of stopping the fake steel trade... And the production of magic storage paper is also going well. But this is what I need to pay particular attention to, right?"

Jin pointed to a report. It was a report on the status of Ziephel's biological golems. The report contained information that entities suspected to be 'Magician's biological golems' had appeared in the demon war.
[Yes, my lord. Those golems you confirmed in Ziephel's sacred place are now being deployed in real battles.]
"Of the 22 biological golems identified so far, 19 are estimated to have a combat power of 8 or 9 stars... It seems similar to the level of the finished products that Kinzello is producing."
The ones who infiltrated the battlefield and wrote the report were the top assassins who remained anonymous. Their evaluation was unlikely to be very different from reality.
[That's correct. But the three bio-golems of commander rank are different.]

"......each one is estimated to be at least a superhuman level, has a clear ego, and possesses command abilities. The names of each individual are Betty, Almatia, and Kun. Moreover, unlike other bio golems that are referred to by identification numbers, these three are treated almost like humans."
Jin read the sentences written in the report aloud, sinking into thought.
'This must be the result of analyzing the magical remnants of Valeria left in the Sanctuary.'
It couldn't be unrelated to Elona.
'Sanctuary' is the residual energy of the Sun God. According to Ameris' estimation, Elona is a being filled with the most powerful solar idea that couldn't be compared to even Veil.
"It seems like the power that Elona Gifle possesses might have made the bio golems overcome their spatial limitations."
[I think the same way. There's definitely a correlation.]
"The important thing is to check the number of bio golems and their production speed."
[The common Magician Golems will be dealt with by our soon-to-be-complete Magic Knight squad and the mass-produced Ielos.]
"Betty, Almatia, Kun. What do you think about these three special entities?"

[I don't think such golems can be mass-produced. They probably used a god or something equivalent as a material. Also, they seem to be more than just combat golems. They are likely golems needed for rituals through the Magic Stone or Tower of Story. However, this is just a conjecture, and I will continue to investigate.]
"Golems to be used in rituals...... somehow, I think the butler's speculation might be correct."

With Elona, an enormous force was added to Gifle once again. However, he wasn't particularly disturbed because he had anticipated this from long ago. Gifle had been researching bio golems since Jin was a reserve rider, and Jin had already personally confirmed their existence in the Sanctuary.

"For the time being, instead of us, the Enemy Races will be diligently digging up information about the bio golems. And Gifle will try hard to figure out their main base based on the Enemy Races they caught last time, so we must not miss the spoon that we are still on."
[Understood, Lord.]

Afterwards, Jin conducted a meeting with Lorette and the former lords for about two hours. Most of the content was about the progress of the key projects of the coalition and about Kinzelo and Elona Gifle.
"......Hoo, it seems like I've roughly sorted things out. Now I should go and watch the competition between Murakan and the knights."
[Lord, while you're here, why don't you join us old folks for a round too? My body's getting stiff because there hasn't been a proper fight since the rescue of Hedo.]
"How can I compete with my ancestors. And I have another place to go, great-grandfather."
[That's too bad. But Murakan would be okay, right? I want to try competing with him just like the other knights. Isn't that right, 20th generation?]
[57th, you're still too vigorous.]
[That's right! Our 20th generation died young and wasn't vigorous enough, that's why he lost to me in the last bet, hahaha!]
[Argh.]
Alpen furrowed his brows as if annoyed, but he had no words to say. He had no choice but to admit that Ballas' name was ranked higher than his own due to losing the 'Destroy the Red Fleet' bet.

'The actual power could certainly be higher for the 57th, who has trained for a longer time, but in terms of historical achievements, my father is overwhelmingly superior. He is showing off his cute side again by foolishly making bets he doesn't need to and losing them.'
Tasha grinned and fist-bumped with Ballas behind Alpen. Both of them were engrossed in the fun of teasing Alpen.
"Please refrain from dueling with Murakan today, great-grandfather. Instead, I will mention it to Murakan another day."
[If our great-grandson... no, if the lord tells me to do so, then I must!]
[57th, how about settling the score with Murakan next time you duel. The one who gets more recognition from Murakan will have their name ranked higher.]
[Heh heh, that's good. Don't regret it. There will be no excuses this time.]
At the training ground, the duels between Murakan and the knights were in full swing.

[Everyone is doing great. But you need to be a little more daring. As I have explained multiple times, even though I'm only sparring, you should treat it exactly like real combat. Regardless of what you do, I won't get injured or die.]
Murakan, not transformed into his true form, was pushing back the charging knights without a break.

There were magic knights who rushed at him using storage paper. While they couldn't perfectly perform a magic knight-like battle yet, if they could just improve their proficiency with storage paper a little more, they seemed capable of terrifying their enemies.
The duel ended in the evening.
"We will finish the duel now. You've all worked hard, Knights of Runcandel."
With a deeply resonant voice, Murakan dismissed the knights.
"Now let's go to Keitam."

"Yes, the knights were more spirited than I thought, so it was somewhat enjoyable. Those youngsters from the youngest division have grown so much. They were just kids who couldn't catch an orc group."
[Murakan, as promised, we should give you a reward. Take this. It's the only spring picture book in the world.]
Leot handed out the spring picture book he had brought with him, wearing a cheeky smile.
"Heh heh... It's very rewarding. Yes, Leot. I knew you could get such an item. I've never seen such a bright red cover. There's no doubt it's going to be an amazing item."
[Then, the two of you, see you next time.]
The red owl carrying the two soon entered spatial leap, and Murakan, filled with anticipation, unfolded the spring picture book.
"...Aaargh! What's this. Leot, you rascal!"
The spring picture book was filled with poorly drawn naked men... and the name of the artist written on the last page was, Leot Hister.
